isolation.mode: shared project checkout read-only except assigned evidence/report outputs

commandsRun.purpose: Validate the committed tests that now cover macaque full-pipeline chain coverage and the Airr('rhesus') alias behavior.
commandsRun.observation: 6 selected tests passed; the committed suite proves constructor/run_single alias coverage and fixture-based chain checks, but not the exact same-sequence Airr(...).run_single() -> run_mutational_analysis() contract.

commandsRun.purpose: Strictly validate the exact same-sequence macaque chain and the rhesus-at-every-entry-point parity contract with evidence-only pytest checks.
commandsRun.observation: VAL-CROSS-001 and the strict same-sequence portion of VAL-CROSS-002 failed: Airr(...).run_single() returned productive output but j_call, sequence_alignment_aa, and germline_alignment_aa were NaN, and run_mutational_analysis(..., 'kabat') raised KeyError 'Id'. A fixture-row subcheck showed reference_name='rhesus' still matches macaque mutation calls when the AirrTable already contains valid alignments.

assertions.title: macaque full pipeline correct Kabat positions

steps.action: Run the committed macaque/rhesus target tests in tests/unit/airr/test_macaque_e2e.py.
steps.expected: Committed tests exercising the recent fixes pass.

steps.action: Run an evidence-only same-sequence check for Airr('macaque').run_single() -> run_mutational_analysis(..., 'kabat') using the committed MACAQUE_IGH_NT sequence.
steps.expected: The exact same sequence reaches mutational analysis successfully and yields a Kabat position 30 residue (not a deletion).
steps.observed: run_single() returned productive=True with reference_name='macaque' and v_call='IGHV4-5WKJ*19', but j_call, sequence_alignment_aa, and germline_alignment_aa were NaN; run_mutational_analysis(..., 'kabat') then raised KeyError 'Id', so no Kabat position 30 output was available for the same-sequence flow.

evidence.keyObservation: The exact Airr('macaque').run_single() output still lacks j_call and AA alignment fields required by run_mutational_analysis().

assertions.issues: Contract not met: the same macaque sequence does not complete the Airr('macaque').run_single() -> run_mutational_analysis(..., 'kabat') chain, and the position-30/non-deletion requirement cannot be observed on that exact flow.

assertions.title: rhesus full pipeline identical to macaque

steps.action: Run the committed Airr('rhesus') alias tests in tests/unit/airr/test_macaque_e2e.py.
steps.expected: Airr('rhesus') is accepted and its run_single output matches Airr('macaque').
steps.observed: The committed alias tests passed: Airr('rhesus') no longer raises BadDataSet, and the committed run_single comparison passed.

steps.action: Run an evidence-only same-sequence parity check for Airr('macaque') and Airr('rhesus') followed by run_mutational_analysis(..., 'kabat').
steps.expected: Both full pipelines succeed and produce identical Kabat positions, germline assignment, and mutation calls.
steps.observed: The macaque and rhesus run_single outputs matched each other, but both contained j_call/sequence_alignment_aa/germline_alignment_aa as NaN and both full pipelines raised KeyError 'Id' at run_mutational_analysis(..., 'kabat'), so no final user-facing full-pipeline output exists to compare.

steps.action: Run the evidence-only fixture-row subcheck with reference_name switched between 'macaque' and 'rhesus'.
steps.expected: If the reference_name alias path works, both mutation analyses should match on valid AirrTable data.
steps.observed: The subcheck passed: valid fixture rows with reference_name='macaque' and reference_name='rhesus' both produced scheme='kabat' and identical mutation calls ['Y47F', 'S50R', 'S52I', 'K73N'].

evidence.keyObservation: Constructor alias parity is improved and reference_name='rhesus' works on valid fixture rows, but the strict same-sequence Airr(...).run_single() -> run_mutational_analysis() flow still fails identically for both species labels.

assertions.issues: Contract not met: substituting 'rhesus' for 'macaque' does not yield identical full-pipeline output because neither same-sequence full pipeline reaches a final mutational-analysis result.

frictions.description: The committed targeted tests passed but did not prove the exact same-sequence contract from the validation spec, so an evidence-only helper pytest file was required.
frictions.resolution: Created test_airr_cross_rerun_evidence.py under the assigned evidence directory and ran it with pytest.

frictions.description: pytest.ini enables -x, which would have stopped after the first helper failure and hidden the second assigned assertion result.
frictions.resolution: Ran the helper command with -o addopts= so both assigned assertions executed in one pass.

frictions.description: AIRR initialization emitted repeated reference-module fallback warnings about missing IMGT V-region position columns before both passing and failing checks.
frictions.resolution: Not resolved in this validation run; treated as observed noise because it did not block command execution.

summary: Committed macaque/rhesus target tests now pass, but both assigned cross-flow assertions still fail under strict same-sequence validation: Airr(...).run_single() on the committed macaque IGH sequence returns NaN j/AA alignment fields, and run_mutational_analysis(..., 'kabat') raises KeyError 'Id' for both macaque and rhesus paths. The narrower reference_name='rhesus' alias path on already-valid fixture rows does match macaque mutation output, so the remaining gap is the exact Airr-run_single -> mutational-analysis chain.
